description: Document claims identity ANOOP (F1000001) but the photo has been swapped to ASHRAY (the forger). The forger presents his own live selfie at the checkpoint.
expected_module2_result: checksum_pass=true, db_status=clear (document itself is not flagged - that's the whole point)
expected_module4_result: match (forger IS the person in the swapped photo - Module 4 alone is fooled)
expected_module5_result: mismatch (document photo does not match the authority reference for F1000001, which is ANOOP's real face, not ASHRAY's)
